name: cloud-web-scraper-web

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle

//: tsc is TypeScript 7, installed as @typescript/native so its binary keeps the plain name. typescript is aliased to 6.0 for the compiler API that 7.0 does not ship and typescript-eslint imports.
eslint-plugin-react-hooks enforces the rules of hooks and the rules of React the React Compiler assumes; eslint.config.mjs wires it.
babel-plugin-react-compiler memoizes components and hooks at build time; vite.config.ts runs it through @rolldown/plugin-babel, whose @babel/core peer eslint-plugin-react-hooks already pulls in.
